description: Department  of Fiscal Policy - Excise Duty on Liquor, w.e.f. 10.11.2017 Excise Notification No. 1000
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the amendment of excise duties on various types of liquor, which is a regulatory matter under the Excise Ordinance. It falls under Legal/Regulatory (Type 5) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to issue new regulations and rescind previous ones, focusing on the legal framework for taxation rather than government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
